title: Thriver of Metastatic Breast Cancer
content: Thriver of Metastatic Breast CancerRadical Remission ProjectFeb 5, 20251 min readA registered nurse for 35 years, Maree is a passionate health care professional that splits her working life between a cardiac catheterization lab and running an integrative nurse-led therapy practice from home. The diagnosis of Metastatic Breast Carcinoma brought a deep inward journey to deepen self awareness and the realisation that we must fundamentally transform the way in which we provide cancer therapy. Maree has had no evidence of disease for almost 5 years.
